outcome: breastfeeding proportion at six weeks postpartum
breastfeeding proportion at six months postpartum
breastfeeding proportion at twelve months postpartum
cohort: The study included 350 women with axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) who had 417 births, with data collected from a nationwide quality register in Norway.
finding: The study found that women with active inflammatory disease (higher ASDAS-CRP, BASDAI, CRP, VAS pain, VAS fatigue) and those who underwent C-section were less likely to breastfeed for longer durations.
mod_finding: A larger proportion of non-breastfeeding women had delivered with caesarean section (41%) compared to breastfeeding women (20%).
